plan.title: Counter Offer Accepted During RFQ Evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen with Vendor A’s normal bid during evaluation.
Ensure RFQ counter offers are available.
Ensure the eRFX project flow is enabled.
Open the buyer comparison grid, where the vendor counter-offer action is supported.
Send Vendor A a counter offer changing the price from 100 to 90.
Verify the counter offer was initiated for Vendor A.
Use Vendor A’s vendor portal session to accept the pending counter offer.
Verify the buyer’s Responses grid marks Vendor A’s counter offer as accepted.
Verify the accepted counter offer is counted in the appropriate panel.
Return to Master QCS to verify the accepted bid values.
Verify Vendor A’s current unit price is 90.
Verify Vendor A’s total is 90 multiplied by 10 units.
Verify the Master QCS amount arithmetic remains correct after acceptance.
